The '''Great Reconciliation''' was an event that occurred hundreds of years before [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], undertaken by an insectoid race called the [[T'kkrpk]]. Following the Great Reconciliation, the T'kkrpks began calculating time in Standard.
